run_batch_inference: run batch inference on a HuggingFace dataset using the stanza pipeline with GPU support
run_stanza_batch_pipeline: run the stanza batch pipeline against a dataset split using environment variable configuration
review_batch_entry_point: review the batch entry point script that wires environment variables to the inference pipeline
summarize_batch_script: summarize the batch inference script that reads dataset config from environment variables and calls the batch function
test_batch_invocation: test the batch function invocation with dataset name, split, column, and GPU settings from environment variables
